sn9.6:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho Kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe || || Atha kho aññatarā Tāvatiṃsa-kāyikā devatā Jālinī nāma āyasmato Anuruddhassa purāṇa-dutiyikā yenāyasmā Anuruddho ten-upasaṅkami || || Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Anuruddhaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn9.6:2.1: Tattha cittam paṇidhehi || yattha te vusitaṃ pure || Tāvatiṃsesu devesu || sabbakāmasamiddhisu || purakkhato parivuto || devakaññāhi sobhasi || ||
sn9.6:3.1: Duggatā devakaññāyo || sakkāyasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā || te cāpi duggatā sattā || devakaññābhipattikā || || Na
sn9.6:4.1: te sukham pajānanti || ye na passanti Nandanaṃ || āvāsaṃ naradevānaṃ || tidasānam yasassinan ti || ||
sn9.6:5.1: Na tvam bāle vijānāsi || yathā arahataṃ vaco || aniccā sabbe saṅkhārā || uppadavayadhammino || uppajjitvā nirujjhanti || tesaṃ vūpasamo sukho || ||
sn9.6:6.1: natthidāni punāvāso || devakāyasmiṃ Jālinī || vikkhīṇo jātisaṃsāro || natthi dāni punabbhavo ti || ||
